title: noisy after just two days
text: noisy after just two days. Great looking clock, which initially was perfectly silent - as advertized.  However after just two full days of use, it now makes a ratcheting/ticking sound, and the second hand no longer sweeps smoothly.  We are debating whether to send back for replacement, or forget it altogether.
